name: Unidentified Jedi world
description: A forgotten Jedi world was a planet that was claimed to exist in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Jedi Master Gnost-Dural suggested this planet as a possible destination for the evacuation during the Invasion of Ossus in 3628 BBY.
